description.narrative: I.OP.1.3: Percentage of the trained CSO representatives that receive a positive assessment from the trainers regarding the application of the newly acquired skills at the end of the training modules

comment.narrative: Of the CSO members and media practitioners who participated in the training programme so far 95 confirmed the usefulness of the training contents for their daily work Indicator 1.1.3. This selfassessment was confirmed by a trainer assessment of the participants during the workshop which shows that 77 of the participants presented a basic sound or excellent level of skillknowledge application during the workshops. To assess the participants skill and knowledge application the trainers rated the participants individual performances at the end of the workshops on a scale from 1 to 5 1 weak knowledge skill application 2 developing knowledge skill application 3 basic knowledge skill application 4 sound knowledge skill application 5 excellent knowledge skill application.
